code_qualification.baseline_objective: Original: native + ramp*(0*bands + 0*edge). Extension: native + ramp*sum(empty weights). Same mathematical objective; different backward graph.
code_qualification.causality: The impact of the zero-weight backward branches has not been tested on this model/GPU. No root-cause attribution is made.
code_qualification.preflight_coverage: Prior strict audit compares shared per-term losses/gradients and optimizer resume, not the original full baseline train_arm loop against the new baseline loop.
code_qualification.calibration: Fresh Colab calibration is intentional for constrained runs; baseline weights are empty, so calibration coefficients do not explain baseline differences.
code_qualification.runtime: Exact historical numerical environment has not been fully reconstructed. Original requested a 3g.40gb MIG allocation; Colab records A100-SXM4-80GB.

preservation: No running job, notebook, package, checkpoint, calibration or result was changed. No GPU experiments launched.
